apps.localizedDescription: Camlo（开幕）是一款零门槛 iOS / iPadOS 原生 Core Animation (.tendies / CAML) 动态与滑动变身锁屏制作工坊。内置 120Hz 原生 `.ca` 实时交互试穿、陀螺仪 3D 裸眼视差 (ParameterizedCA)、昼夜双生壁纸 (appearanceAware)、智能时钟配色字体与主屏柔焦配套、6 套内置获奖风光双态预设与 50 套零体积馆藏大师级官方云端壁纸、8 款异形粒子与体积流光特效、AI 主体抠图遮挡时钟、视频/实况抽帧无缝循环与免电脑一键直写 iOS 26 / iOS 27 锁屏画廊。

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's New in Camlo v1.3.1 (Build 24)

### 1. 10 Original 「次元 3D (Anime 3D)」 Cloud Wallpapers (`ParameterizedCA` + Apple Vision Clock Depth)
- Official zero-bloat Cloud Gallery (`wallpapers/`) expanded from 60 to **70 packs** (**395+ total** across Official + Community channels), while keeping `Camlo_v1.3.1_Bilingual.ipa` ultra-slim at **~9.5 MB (`9.1 MiB`)**.
- All 10 new 100%-original Anime packs (`18961`–`18970`) are natively compiled as single-screen **`ParameterizedCA` (`Marble` / `wantsDeviceMotion = true`)** bundles with **real hardware 120Hz 3D Gyroscope Parallax**, **Apple Vision foreground cutouts occluding the `09:41` clock**, **3-state (`Sleep → Locked → Unlock`) morphing**, and **hardware `CAEmitterLayer` / volumetric particles**:
  1. `18961` · **墨线初醒 · 樱绘少女** (*Ink Sketch Bloom · Sakura*) — Obsidian ink sketch blooming into full color & drifting sakura
  2. `18962` · **赛博视界 · 瞳孔开机** (*Cyber Visor · Wake Protocol*) — Standby cyber courier awakening cyan/magenta visor rings
  3. `18963` · **雨岸平交道 · 破云霞光** (*Rainy Crossing · Sunbreak*) — Coastal rain clearing into amber cumulonimbus sunbeams
  4. `18964` · **狐面鸟居 · 千灯夜祭** (*Kitsune Torii · Lantern Festival*) — Midnight shrine igniting vermilion-gold lanterns & maple sparks
  5. `18965` · **猩红爵士 · 破屏切入** (*Crimson Velvet · Cut-In*) — Monochrome phantom erupting into crimson & gold-leaf graphic cut-in
  6. `18966` · **天台星镜 · 流星夜话** (*Rooftop Observatory · Meteors*) — Twilight refractor telescope awakening Milky Way & meteor shower
  7. `18967` · **深夜窗猫 · 暖灯可可** (*Midnight Desk · Cat & Cocoa*) — Cool moonlit Lo-Fi study switching on honey-amber lamp light
  8. `18968` · **星穹魔女 · 古铜星盘** (*Astral Witch · Celestial Astrolabe*) — Silver-braided witch awakening molten-gold celestial rings & butterflies
  9. `18969` · **格纳库整备 · 光翼出击** (*Orbital Hangar · Wing Ignition*) — Titanium mecha standby igniting emerald optics & azure plasma wings
  10. `18970` · **松崖剑意 · 破晓青莲** (*Cliff Pine Swordswoman · Lotus Dawn*) — Moonlit swordswoman awakening golden cloud-sea dawn & jade lotus aura

### 2. Cloud Gallery `Anime 3D` Category & Scrollable Pill Filter
- Adds dedicated **`次元 3D / Anime 3D`** filter chip and upgrades the Cloud Gallery filter bar to a horizontal scrollable pill row with live pack counters.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

## What's New in Camlo v1.3.0

### 📱 Native iPhone Duo Dual-Screen Canvas (Inner + Outer)
- Compiles unified WallpaperKit `<wallpapers>` `ParameterizedCA` packages embedding both the **Outer Cover** (`466×678` pt) and **Inner Unfolded Landscape** (`951×669` pt) canvases with `requiresLandscapeScaling = true`, scaled gyro parallax, and synchronized `Sleep / Locked / Unlock` transitions.
- Auto-detects **iPhone Duo (`iPhone19,4`)** and switches Slide-to-Morph Studio & Video Studio to dual-screen mode by default (with manual toggle available on every iPhone).
- Interactive **Outer / Inner live preview switcher**, landscape crop guides, dual Vision AI foreground clock-depth cutouts, and 120Hz `.ca` preview support in Vault X-Ray.

### 🎨 10 Exclusive iPhone Duo Official Cloud Packs (60 Official · 385+ Total)
- Added a dedicated **iPhone Duo** category in Cloud Gallery with **10 bespoke museum-grade Inner+Outer packs** (8 Dual-Screen Depth Morph + 2 Dual-Screen Living Cinemagraphs) hosted outside the IPA for zero app bloat (~9.1 MB IPA).
